title: Umami Crispy Japanese Chicken Gyoza
description: A low-sodium Japanese dish featuring crispy chicken gyoza with umami flavors, perfect for a midnight craving. It is made with sesame seed oil and broiled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, green onions, garlic, ginger, and soy sauce, and mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Brush the tops of the gyoza with sesame seed oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Place the gyoza on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and broil for 5 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the gyoza hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
